plan: Deep-copy the recipe into a working structure and scale every quantity (top-level and per-component) by the exact Fraction ratio target_yield / recipe yield.

Resolve each ingredient through a substitution chain: while its name is excluded, pick the catalog choice with lowest numeric priority (catalog order breaks ties); a repeat name in the chain's seen-set yields 'substitution cycle involving NAME', a missing choice yields 'no substitution for NAME'.

Applying a choice rewrites name/quantity/unit/preparation, records wording-change pairs, applies equipment additions/removals, and enqueues additional ingredients; queued extras run through the same resolver, giving chained substitutions and re-detection of reintroduced exclusions.

After all chains, apply the ordered wording changes to every instruction string (including component instructions), sort the final equipment list, and record 'equipment NAME unavailable' for anything outside available_equipment.

Collect reasons in a set across all ingredients and equipment so every independently applicable failure is reported (sorted); on success regenerate authored_text for the adapted recipe, return ordered choice IDs and sorted warnings; print_original returns the stored authored_text byte-for-byte; inputs are never mutated.
mechanisms: exact Fraction yield-scaling of a deep-copied working recipe
per-ingredient substitution chain resolver with seen-set cycle detection
deterministic catalog selection keyed on (priority, catalog index)
work queue for substitution-introduced additional ingredients (re-subject to exclusions)
deferred ordered wording-change application to instruction strings
equipment reconciliation (add/remove then subset check against available_equipment)
exhaustive reason accumulation into a sorted, deduplicated list
regenerated authored_text for adapted output; original authored_text returned verbatim
